actions.title: Prepare the numbered dependency-review attempt
actions.instruction: In a native terminal at the Academy clone root, run Prepare from clean main.
actions.expected_result: Academy prints academy/P04-review-a-dependency/ATTEMPT_NUMBER and switches to that branch.
actions.recovery: Preserve an error and resolve only its named condition before retrying.
actions.evidence: The branch binds later evidence to one prepared project state.

actions.title: Read the no-install boundary
actions.instruction: Use the website as the primary lesson surface before asking an agent to review the proposal. This beginner path teaches rejection only.
actions.rationale: Review is evidence about a proposal, not permission to change project state.
actions.expected_result: You can state that Academy CLI only handles Prepare, Check, and Reset and that this lesson does not add a dependency declaration, environment lock, or Academy wrapper.
actions.recovery: If you expected package adoption, stop and return to the course boundary.
actions.evidence: No repository evidence has been created yet.

actions.title: Read the frozen candidate set
actions.instruction: Read the committed candidate set in the native terminal. It is offline evidence, not a live registry query.
actions.rationale: The review must name exact candidate bytes.
actions.expected_result: It identifies python-dateutil 2.9.0.post0, its six closure, digests, and review-only-never-install policy.
actions.recovery: If the file is absent or differs, stop. Do not fetch or substitute it.
actions.evidence: The review begins from committed candidate evidence.

actions.title: Confirm the project has not changed
actions.instruction: Inspect status in the native terminal before review evidence is written.
actions.recovery: If Git prints a path, preserve it outside this attempt or use Reset. Do not hide it in history.

actions.title: Inspect the supplied wheel metadata
actions.instruction: List each prepared wheel. This reads archives only; it does not install or import either package.
actions.rationale: Metadata is evidence about a supplied archive, not a live registry.
actions.expected_result: Each archive lists metadata and license payload without changing the environment.
actions.recovery: If Python cannot read an archive, preserve the error and Reset. Do not download a replacement.
actions.evidence: The report can cite artifact-local metadata.

actions.title: Recompute the wheel digests
actions.instruction: Hash both supplied wheels and compare them with candidate-set.json.
actions.rationale: A name and version are insufficient; the review binds to bytes.
actions.expected_result: The SHA-256 values match the frozen candidate set exactly.
actions.recovery: If either digest differs, stop and Reset.
actions.evidence: The report can bind its candidate and closure statements to archive bytes.

actions.title: Read the bundled license evidence
actions.instruction: Read the two wheel-derived licenses and Apache text. Do not invent a NOTICE or patent payload.
actions.rationale: License claims need named local source material.
actions.expected_result: You can name both wheel-derived licenses and Apache text; the prepared set has no NOTICE payload.
actions.recovery: If a named file is absent, stop. Do not add a replacement.
actions.evidence: The report distinguishes observed terms from unobserved ones.

actions.title: Assess frozen provenance limits
actions.instruction: Ask the active agent to explain candidate provenance and supply-chain signals, then compare its answer with the files you read. Treat maintenance and vulnerability statements as the frozen 2026-07-31 snapshot, never live registry or CVE truth.
actions.rationale: The learner reviews the time boundary, not an agent summary.
actions.expected_result: You can distinguish archive evidence from time-bounded maintenance and vulnerability observations.
actions.recovery: Do not add a live claim without inspectable source evidence.
actions.evidence: Your decision remains limited to supplied evidence and its review date.

actions.title: Compare the bounded standard-library alternative
actions.instruction: Ask the agent to compare finite-format datetime.strptime parsing with the two-wheel closure across every SMARTS lens. Require length limits, explicit formats, deterministic defaults, and fail-closed trailing content.
actions.rationale: The capability need is smaller than the package surface.
actions.expected_result: You can explain why bounded datetime.strptime is sufficient for this finite-format exercise.
actions.recovery: If requirements broaden beyond finite formats, stop and record a separate decision.
actions.evidence: The rejection is a capability comparison, not an unsupported safety assertion.

actions.title: Let the agent draft the review
actions.instruction: After inspecting the frozen evidence, ask the active agent to invoke the host-native dependency review lane. The agent drafts the report; it does not install, change dependency files, or choose for you.
actions.rationale: The host lane structures the report while the learner retains the decision.
actions.expected_result: The agent drafts .codearbiter/reports/academy/P04-dependency-review.md with candidate, closure, license, provenance, supply-chain, compatibility, alternatives, and SMARTS evidence.
actions.recovery: If the agent changes dependency state, stop and Reset.
actions.evidence: The draft names the sole report later committed.

actions.title: Review the drafted evidence
actions.instruction: Read the draft with the active agent and compare it with the candidate-set, hashes, and licenses. Confirm it labels the 2026-07-31 snapshot and not live registry or CVE truth.
actions.rationale: A formatted report is not a learner decision.
actions.expected_result: You can identify candidate, closure, no-install policy, bounded alternative, and SMARTS comparison.
actions.recovery: Ask the agent to correct any claim unsupported by prepared files before you choose.
actions.evidence: The final report reflects reviewed local evidence.

actions.title: Select the rejection decision
actions.instruction: Tell the agent you select the rejection path: bounded datetime.strptime for finite formats and Decision: reject. Do not ask the agent to select for you.
actions.rationale: The learner owns the tradeoff; the agent records it.
actions.expected_result: The report says the bounded standard-library alternative is selected and ends with Decision: reject.
actions.recovery: If the formats are not finite and bounded, stop. That is a new requirement decision.
actions.evidence: The report preserves the decision and rationale, but not an authenticated account of who chose it.

actions.title: Stage only the review report
actions.instruction: Stage the report in the native terminal and inspect the staged path list before asking the agent to commit it.
actions.rationale: The rejection path commits only evidence.
actions.expected_result: The staged path list contains exactly .codearbiter/reports/academy/P04-dependency-review.md.
actions.recovery: If another path appears, preserve it and unstage only that unrelated path.
actions.evidence: The pending commit boundary makes the no-install decision inspectable.

actions.title: Let the agent commit the review evidence
actions.instruction: After you approve the one staged path, ask the active agent to invoke the host-native commit gate. This is a harness command, not a shell command.
actions.rationale: The governed commit records review without changing the dependency surface.
actions.recovery: If the gate blocks, preserve its finding and resolve the report boundary. Do not use a raw commit.
actions.evidence: Check can recompute the report and commit-path boundary.

actions.title: Confirm the dependency surface stayed untouched
actions.instruction: Inspect the final commit and worktree in the native terminal before Check. The review report is the only new committed path.
actions.rationale: A rejection leaves application dependency state unchanged.
actions.expected_result: The final commit names only the review report, Git is clean, and pyproject.toml, requirements.lock, and the Academy approval wrapper remain unchanged or absent.
actions.recovery: If another path is committed or uncommitted, preserve the attempt and Reset. Do not rewrite it to look clean.
actions.evidence: The final state separates review evidence from adoption.

actions.title: Run external Academy Check
actions.instruction: Run installed Academy Check from the prepared clone in the native terminal.
actions.rationale: Check recomputes facts without trusting a transcript.
actions.expected_result: Check reports a passed P04 checkpoint and records progress only after valid evidence.
actions.recovery: If Check fails, preserve the attempt and read its named predicate before Reset.
actions.evidence: Check proves candidate binding, report structure, unchanged dependency surfaces, commit ancestry, and clean state. It does not prove that you ran a host command, and it does not authenticate your review or selection.

actions.title: Preserve and reset a failed attempt
actions.instruction: Use Reset only for a new attempt or when Check directs recovery. It preserves failed evidence before restoring the prepared baseline.
actions.rationale: Failed reviews are evidence and must not be erased.
actions.expected_result: Academy preserves the numbered attempt and prints the next safe start.
actions.recovery: If Reset refuses, preserve its output. Never force-reset, rebase, or delete evidence.
